comment: botl.c parse_status_hl2() stores the table spelling of a text threshold: enc_stat[] for carrying-capacity and hu_stat[] (trimmed at 3096) for hunger, which are capitalised, and aligntxt[] for alignment, which is not (2903-2916); a field with no table, such as title, keeps the text parse_status_hl1() lowercased. The rc rules use mixed case; the status highlight rules editor then shows every listing: config format and each field. A typed hilite_status value in #optionsfull reaches the same parser through parseoptions() and is listed again. Seed, clock, character and keys chosen for this case.
